# Embed

<!-- START TOKEN(Autogenerated block API docs) -->
**Name:** `core/embed`
**Category:** [embed](/docs/reference-guides/core-blocks/category-embed.md)
**API Version:** [3](/docs/reference-guides/block-api/block-api-versions/)
**Block Type:** [Static](/docs/getting-started/fundamentals/static-dynamic-rendering.md) (saved in post content)

> Add a block that displays content pulled from other sites, like Twitter or YouTube.

## Supports

_Defined via the [`supports`](/docs/reference-guides/block-api/block-supports.md) property in block.json._

- [`anchor`](/docs/reference-guides/block-api/block-supports.md#anchor): `true`

## Block Markup

This is a [**static block**](/docs/getting-started/fundamentals/static-dynamic-rendering.md). The markup is saved directly in the post content.

```html
<!-- wp:embed {"allowResponsive":true,"responsive":false,"previewable":true} -->
<!-- Content... -->
<!-- /wp:embed -->
```
